h2. Description

*The Technician filter must list everyone who has a group in Tech View or a column in Board View.* On staging 11 people have their own group and column but cannot be picked in the filter.

For example,
* Tech View shows 329 technician groups and Board View 340 columns, but the Technician filter offers 317 names
* every name in the filter has a group, but these have a group and no filter entry: Aimee Francis, Allison Hughes, Brett Guerra, Darrell Martinez, Debra Taylor, James Price, Jared Miller, Mary Parker, Rebecca Mitchell, ZZAUTOTEST F3 Dan Delta, Deleted technician

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin at *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and click *Board View*. Clear any filter and the search.
# Scroll the board to the right until the *Aimee Francis* column.
#* Aimee Francis has her own column.
# Click the *Technician* filter and type *Aimee* in *Search technician*.
#* No name is offered.

*Actual Result:*
* Aimee Francis (and 10 others) have a column and a Tech View group but are not in the Technician filter, so their work cannot be filtered.

*Expected Result:*
* The PRD says: *"In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then everyone who gets a group or column at this location: the location’s technicians (S9-R4), and any lead technician who keeps a column while still leading work orders here (deactivated, S2-N2 and S3-N2; not enrolled here, S3-R20b; Time Clock turned off, S3-R20d)."*
